convertibility_reason: Uses iCustom() to load a custom indicator 'ColorZerolagTriXOSMA' with 12 parameters, and depends on external .mqh library (TradeAlgorithms.mqh) for all trade execution logic including position open/close, lot sizing, and global variable management.

derived_values.name: min_rates_total - minimum bars needed for indicator calculation
TimeShiftSec - timeframe period in seconds
derived_values.used_by: UpSignalTime and DnSignalTime calculation for trade signal timestamps

other_exits: Close long when ColorZerolagTriXOSMA[1] < ColorZerolagTriXOSMA[2] (sell signal triggers BUY_Close if BuyPosClose=true)
Close short when ColorZerolagTriXOSMA[1] > ColorZerolagTriXOSMA[2] (buy signal triggers SELL_Close if SellPosClose=true)

position_sizing.conditional_logic: MMMode=LOT means fixed lot size; MMMode=FREEMARGIN/BALANCE/LOSSFREEMARGIN/LOSSBALANCE means MM fraction of respective deposit measure. Input MM=0.1 interpreted differently based on MMMode selection.

custom_logic_notes: Entry signal logic: Reads 3 consecutive values from ColorZerolagTriXOSMA buffer starting at SignalBar. If Value[1]<Value[2] (indicator was falling between bars SignalBar+1 and SignalBar+2): buy opens if Value[0]>Value[1] (indicator turned up at bar SignalBar) and BuyPosOpen=true; sell closes if SellPosClose=true. Opposite for sell signal. The BuyPosOpen/SellPosOpen/SellPosClose/BuyPosClose input booleans gate each direction independently. The trade execution functions (BuyPositionOpen, SellPositionOpen, BuyPositionClose, SellPositionClose) are all from TradeAlgorithms.mqh and handle position existence checks internally. Signal timestamp (UpSignalTime/DnSignalTime) is passed to open functions, likely used for bar-duplicate trade prevention.
python_conversion_notes: The ColorZerolagTriXOSMA custom indicator must be replicated in Python - it is a zero-lag TRIX OSMA oscillator combining 5 weighted TRIX components. The signal logic is a momentum reversal: indicator falling (bar[1]<bar[2]) then turning up (bar[0]>bar[1]) = buy; vice versa for sell. TradeAlgorithms.mqh provides all position management including lot sizing modes (LOT, FREEMARGIN, BALANCE, LOSSFREEMARGIN, LOSSBALANCE), position existence checks, deviation handling, and global variable cleanup - these must all be reimplemented. The SignalBar input (default=1) shifts which bar the signal reads from; when SignalBar=0 the new-bar guard is bypassed allowing tick-level entry. Position gate logic is encapsulated in the external library functions, so the exact duplicate-trade prevention mechanism needs inspection of TradeAlgorithms.mqh.
